- Tue: 13:00-13:30, 16:30-17:00

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Alison, I've checked all the slots you provided against Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, none of them work for all four partners:

- Mon 09:00-09:30: Elena busy (Contract review), David busy (Quarterly planning)
- Tue 13:00-13:30: Elena busy (Quarterly planning), David busy (Client call)
- Tue 16:30-17:00: Elena busy (Hiring panel), David busy (Travel)
- Wed 15:00-15:30: David busy (Partner lunch)
- Thu 13:30-14:00: Elena busy (Board prep), David busy
- Fri 11:00-11:30: Elena busy (Client dinner prep), David busy (Training session)

Every slot has at least one conflict. There is no 30-minute window next week when all four partners are free. I'm reporting this as infeasible.

infeasible.reason: After checking all calendar constraints, there is no 30-minute slot next week (Nov 16-20, 9:00-17:00 ET) when all four partners are simultaneously available.
